knowledge:
- key_parameters: index_prefix=Prefix path where the reference genome index files are stored or will be created ;; fastq_files=Path to the input FASTQ file(s) containing read sequences ;; sai_files=Path to the intermediate .sai file(s) generated by bwa_aln ;; sam_file=Path to the output SAM file ;; n=Maximal edit distance between the query sequence and the reference genome (passed to bwa_aln) ;; k=Maximal edit distance in the seed sequence (passed to bwa_aln) ;; l=Length of the seed sequence (passed to bwa_aln)
- alternatives: BWA-backtrack (bwa_aln) is designed for short Illumina reads (up to 100bp), whereas BWA-MEM (bwa_mem) is more suitable for longer sequences (70bp to 1Mbp) and supports split alignment.
- when_to_use: Use when aligning short DNA sequencing reads to a reference genome directly within an R session.
- pitfalls: bwa_aln does not output a SAM file directly; it produces an intermediate .sai file that must be converted to SAM using bwa_sam. Both bwa_aln and bwa_mem require a pre-built genome index, which must be created first using bwa_build_index.

workflows.name: bwa_backtrack_alignment
workflows.intent: Align short DNA sequencing reads (up to 100bp) to a reference genome using BWA-backtrack, generating intermediate SAI files and converting them to SAM format.
workflows.stages: 1. Build reference genome index using bwa_build_index ;; 2. Align reads to the index using bwa_aln to generate an intermediate .sai file ;; 3. Convert the .sai file to a .sam file using bwa_sam ;; 4. (Optional) Expand secondary alignments from XA tags using xa2multi
workflows.code:
dir <- tempdir()
fasta <- system.file(package="Rbwa",
                     "fasta/chr12.fa")
index_prefix <- file.path(dir, "chr12")
bwa_build_index(fasta,
                index_prefix=index_prefix)
fastq <- system.file(package="Rbwa",
                     "fastq/sequences.fastq")
bwa_aln(index_prefix=index_prefix,
        fastq_files=fastq,
        sai_files=file.path(dir, "output.sai"))
bwa_sam(index_prefix=index_prefix,
        fastq_files=fastq,
        sai_files=file.path(dir, "output.sai"),
        sam_file=file.path(dir, "output.sam"))
xa2multi(file.path(dir, "output.sam"),
         file.path(dir, "output.multi.sam"))

workflows.name: bwa_mem_alignment
workflows.intent: Align longer DNA sequencing reads (70bp to 1Mbp) directly to a reference genome using BWA-MEM, generating a SAM file directly.
workflows.stages: 1. Build reference genome index using bwa_build_index ;; 2. Align reads directly to the index using bwa_mem to generate a .sam file
workflows.code:
dir <- tempdir()
fasta <- system.file(package="Rbwa",
                     "fasta/chr12.fa")
index_prefix <- file.path(dir, "chr12")
bwa_build_index(fasta,
                index_prefix=index_prefix)
fastq <- system.file(package="Rbwa",
                     "fastq/sequences.fastq")
bwa_mem(index_prefix=index_prefix,
        fastq_files=fastq,
        sam_file=file.path(dir, "output.sam"))
